name: Lightning Search
description:
A fast, minimal search launcher for GNOME, inspired by Spotlight. Search applications and files, evaluate calculations, open URLs or web searches, and run terminal commands from a single search box.

Clipboard: activating a calculation result copies it to the clipboard. The extension never reads or shares clipboard data.

Commands: when the first word of a query is an executable on your PATH, a result is offered to run the line. Commands run only when you explicitly activate that result: Enter runs it in the background without a terminal, and Shift + Enter runs it in a visible terminal window. Commands never run with elevated privileges.
